rootCauses.cause: A coarse page with partial settled near coverage remained drawable as one page, and fixed-camera selection caching omitted the spatial near-coverage revision.
rootCauses.fix: Classify page coverage as NONE, PARTIAL, or FULL; refine available PARTIAL pages, mask settled FULL children, retain conservative coarse coverage when children are unavailable, and include near-coverage revision in selection caching.

rootCauses.cause: Fullscreen compatibility aliases used the inverse of the camera-rebased host model-view matrix.
rootCauses.fix: Keep the full host model-view for geometry and publish a player-relative, translation-free model-view alias for fullscreen programs.

rootCauses.cause: A texture that had ever generated mipmaps retained mipmapped minification globally; after composite6 replaced colortex3 level zero, composite7 FXAA sampled stale upper mip levels and produced the block-aligned stipple.
rootCauses.fix: Apply mipmapped minification only while binding a program that declares mipmapsBefore, and restore each target's base filter for ordinary consumers.

rootCauses.cause: Content reload retired skeletal entity buffers in postPrepareDraw while the same frame's Iris shadow traversal still retained them.
rootCauses.fix: Queue entity renderer, feature, model, mesh, item, and armor GPU retirement until postDraw.

rootCauses.cause: World entity iteration retained the entity-index monitor while joining asynchronous ticks, which could wedge local physics and render-thread diagnostics.
rootCauses.fix: Snapshot the entity collection before scheduling and joining asynchronous ticks.

notRepeated.terrainSameNameDifferentWorldReconnect: Requires two isolated saved worlds at the same address and was not repeated against the shared dedicated-server world; the accepted 2026-08-01 evidence and current persistence/network lifecycle tests remain authoritative.
